title: %join — join array elements with a delimiter
purpose: Concatenate the elements of an array into a single string separated by a delimiter.
input:
tags[0] = "a"
tags[1] = "b"
tags[2] = "c"
one[0] = "solo"
nums[0] = ##1
nums[1] = ##2
expectedOutput:
{out}
out = "a, b, c"
pipe = "a|b|c"
single = "solo"
nums = "1-2"
notes: First argument is an array reference; second is the quoted delimiter.
An array source is supplied in ODIN with indexed assignments (tags[0], tags[1], ...).
